annotation.interpretation_b: The stream has been locally initiated (Stream ID assigned) but the initial handshake to establish the stream has not completed.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'has not yet been created' is open to interpretation. It's unclear whether it refers to the assignment of a Stream ID or the completion of the stream establishment handshake. This affects how an implementation would determine if the condition is met and thus whether to trigger a connection error.
annotation.missing_information: The definition of 'created' in the context of a locally-initiated stream is not clear. Does 'created' mean the stream ID has been assigned, or does it require further handshake completion?
